failure.segment_label: California Current exit → Pacific open water
failure.suggested_fix: Upgrade weld class (Premium reduces SCF from 2.65 → 1.50) or increase plate thickness. Higher-grade steel improves yield but not fatigue class without weld improvement.
failure.why: Miner's cumulative damage reached 1.00 at Keel — weld toe cracking likely. S-N curve exhausted by repeated wave loading.
